prompt.en: The General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT) helped open up world trade after the Depression. What is it called today?
prompt.fr: L'Accord général sur les tarifs douaniers et le commerce (GATT) a aidé à ouvrir le commerce mondial après la Crise. Comment s'appelle-t-il aujourd'hui?

options.fr: L'Organisation du Traité de l'Atlantique Nord.

explanation.en: GATT is the trade treaty that became the World Trade Organization.
explanation.fr: Le GATT est le traité commercial devenu l'Organisation mondiale du commerce.

source.quote: The world’s restrictive trading policies in the Depression era were opened up by such treaties as the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT), now the World Trade Organization (WTO).

verification.evidence: such treaties as the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT), now the World Trade Organization (WTO)
